settings.subheading: 9. AI Skin Scanner & Dosha Diagnostic Tools
settings.content:

Not medical advice. The Skin Intelligence Tools are provided for informational and personalisation purposes only. Results, dosha classifications, and product recommendations are not medical diagnoses, dermatological assessments, or health advice. You should consult a qualified healthcare professional or dermatologist for any skin health concerns.

Accuracy

AI-generated skin analysis is based on visible skin characteristics and may not reflect the full complexity of your skin health. Results are indicative only. We do not warrant that the dosha classification or product recommendations will be accurate or suitable for your individual circumstances.

Image data

Use of the AI Skin Scanner requires your consent to real-time processing of your facial image. Your image is not stored. Full details of how image data is handled are set out in our Privacy Policy and AI Skin Scanner Addendum. You must be 18 or over to use the Scanner.
